justification: The avatar is a semi-humanoid energy Citizen with buoyant embodiment, so all three axes are permitted: ZQSD drives the ground plane and E/Space/C drive vertical rise and descent. Piloting is a gated bounded-intent projection: only a `granted` control over the bound Actor turns input into motion, clamped to max_tick_displacement per applied delta so a stalled frame cannot teleport the body. Any axis the contract does NOT permit is refused, never treated as a permitted default — the gate, not the input, decides motion.
